# `start_polar_align`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Start (or restart) polar alignment.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit and 32-bit builds, by command-socket invocation, which always writes shared diagnostics); the effect of the handler itself is probable |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xe10e0, StartPAFunc @0x15fcc0 (type table, F-event name set @0x160194, is_pa_3p gate @0x15fd6c), ThreePointPaFunc @0x162800, SendPaEvent @0x1626c0 (64-bit build) |

Refuses while a ViewPlan is running, then selects the procedure from the mount's equatorial mode: in alt-azimuth mode always the three-point procedure (altaz_3p, is_one_star ignored); in equatorial mode is_one_star true selects the one-star gyro procedure (eq_1p) and false the equatorial three-point procedure (eq_3p). F events are named EqModePA for both equatorial procedures and 3PPA in alt-azimuth mode; the per-stage status event is named 3PPA in every mode. A client SHOULD read the mount mode first and follow the matching F event. If the stored setting is_pa_3p is false the start returns 0 without starting any worker (legacy image-pair mode INFERRED). A session stays active from start until stop_polar_align. With restart true, when the worker is running or an equatorial-mode session is active, the handler first stops the worker and the gyro thread and, if a session is active, restores settings and clears it. Then: a still-running worker gives 268; a different type from the active session clears the old session and starts fresh; no active session starts fresh; an active eq_3p session resumes with its kept stage; an active altaz_3p or eq_1p session gives 268. So restart true gives a fresh start in equatorial mode, and a paused alt-azimuth session gives 268 until stop_polar_align. Starting stops any autogoto, view or exposure first. The calling connection is recorded as the recipient of alignment results. No parked-mount check is made. The ViewPlan check happens before params are parsed, so malformed params can yield 536 first.

Side effects: Stops any autogoto, view or exposure. With restart, stops both alignment threads and restores settings (the stop can block); a type change also restores and clears the old session; then initialises alignment state and starts the worker, which moves the mount and captures images. Records the caller connection.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"start_polar_align"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object | no | - | Optional. Only an object is read; absent, null, scalar or array params run with the defaults (arrays are not positional alternatives). Unknown members are ignored. Observed app encoders send is_one_star alone, or restart with an optional dec_pos_index. [READ] |
| `params.is_one_star` | boolean\|integer | no | false | In equatorial mode, true selects the one-star gyro procedure (eq_1p) and false the equatorial three-point procedure (eq_3p); ignored in alt-azimuth mode. Boolean or integer (nonzero true); a wrong type keeps the default. [READ] |
| `params.restart` | boolean\|integer | no | false | When the worker is running or an equatorial-mode session is active, stop the alignment threads and restore and clear the session before starting, so an equatorial start is fresh; it does not let a paused alt-azimuth session restart (268 until stop). Boolean or integer (nonzero true); a wrong type keeps the default. [READ] |
| `params.dec_pos_index` | integer | no | 3 | Declination position index. Valid 1..5; an integer outside it gives 204. A wrong type keeps the default. Range: >= 1, <= 5. [READ] |

| `jsonrpc` | string | no | - | (both) Added by the socket layer (reply object constructor), not the handler fragment. Normally present; absent on a stop_func relay-failure reply. Receivers MUST NOT require it. Fixed value `"2.0"`. [READ; also OBSERVED on the wire (2026-10-12)] |
| `Timestamp` | string | no | - | (both) Decimal string `<seconds>.<nanoseconds>` with exactly nine fractional digits, formatted with `%ld.%09ld` from clock_gettime clock id 1. Linux clock id 1 is CLOCK_MONOTONIC, so the value is monotonic time, not wall-clock or Unix time (INFERRED from the clock id). On replies it is added by the socket layer and is normally present; receivers MUST NOT require it on replies (absent on a stop_func relay-failure reply). On events it is always written by the event constructor. [READ; wire shape also OBSERVED (2026-10-12)] |

The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 536 | A ViewPlan is running | `view plan is already running` |
| 204 | dec_pos_index is an integer outside 1..5 | `out of limit` |
| 254 | The mount mode could not be read | `mount operation failed` |
| 268 | An alignment worker is still running, or an active altaz_3p or eq_1p session cannot be resumed | `operation is in progress` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

Other failures of the worker start forward the current thread-local error code and are not fully enumerated. Gyro-mode events are not fully audited. With is_pa_3p false the reply is 0 and no worker or event follows.

## Example

Request, defaults:

```json
{"id":81,"method":"start_polar_align"}
```

Request, restart - Restart at position 2:

```json
{"id":82,"method":"start_polar_align","params":{"restart":true,"dec_pos_index":2}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"start_polar_align","result":0,"code":0,"id":81}
```

Reply, plan-running:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"start_polar_align","error":"view plan is already running","code":536,"id":83}
```
